items.title: Perplexity's new Monitor API turns web search from a one-off query into a nonstop watchdog
items.summary: Perplexity is launching a Monitor API that searches the web on a schedule and alerts agents via webhook only when relevant changes occur. items.title: 8万条群聊消息做成考卷：腾讯元宝×KCL发布首个基于群聊构建的Agent记忆基准

extra.evidence: 一个九人出行群，最初商定5月1日出发，后来又改为4月30日。等到有人请AI助手发布购票提醒，它很可能还按旧日期通知。 在群聊的实际场景中，往往还有更隐蔽的要求：谁想坐靠窗位置，谁对预算有要求，哪些安排只是提议，哪些已经成为共同决定。 一个AI助手要服务一群人，关键不只是找回记忆，更是 判断此刻应该使用谁的哪条记忆。 针对这一问题， 腾讯元宝 与 伦敦国王学院NLP 团队联合推出 GroupAssistBench 。研究基于 50个真实群聊、80,299条历史消息 ，构建 2,395道评测题 ，检查Agent记忆能否真正从“记得住”走向“用得好”。 研究团队比较了完整上下文、检索增强和外部记忆等 14组配置 。其中一个有代表性的反差是：EverMemOS在L1记忆召回评测中得分为 0.621 ，高于使用相同任务模型的完整上下文 0.570 ；但在L2开放式服务评测中，它的得分为 0.247 ，低于完整上下文的 0.431 。 已有Agent Memory评测常通过事实问答检验历史回忆，近期也有工作开始关注下游记忆使用。但真实群聊提出了更复杂的问题：同一条信息可能由不同成员补充，安排会随讨论更新，一项回复还可能同时受到多个人的约束。 GroupAssistBench从真实部署群助手的互动中构建数据，保留自然发生的话题切换、状态变化和多人信息交织，并将评测分成两个相互关联的任务层级。 L1记忆召回 有明确的参考事实，例如“最初约定哪天出发”。 L2记忆使用 则要求完成服务，例如“帮大家发出行与购票提醒”，答案没有固定措辞，却必须遵守有效的历史决定和成员要求。两类题目分别有1,374道和1,021道。 研究又根据所依赖的记忆结构划分为 M1单条记忆、M2多记忆整合、M3更新与冲突处理 。M3尤其需要识别：旧决定何时被新决定取代，哪些成员的约束仍然适用。这些类别描述的是信息依赖形式…

items.title: Mind2Act World: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Embodied Mind, Physical Action, and Mind-Action Composition in Robotic Manipulation
items.summary: Embodied intelligence aims to let robots perform complex physical tasks with human-like adaptability and reliability, which requires three complementary capabilities: history-based cognitive reasoning, precise and timely physical execution, and the composition of reasoning and execution through environmental feedback. Yet existing benchmarks either evaluate reasoning and execution within the same tasks or assess them separately without their composition, so they reveal little about whether a failure comes from reasoning, execution, or their composition. We introduce Mind2Act World, a diagnostic benchmark of 30 simulated manipulation tasks from five real-world application domains. Each task has three difficulty levels and two scene settings (Clean and Random), yielding 180 configurations. The tasks form three views: Mind tests decisions based on past observations, Act tests precise and timely execution, and Mind2Act combines both in closed-loop tasks where action outcomes guide later decisions. Comparing the three views shows whether a system lacks a capability or fails to compose capabilities it already has. A diagnosis harness further attributes the failed episodes of three representative systems to Mind, Act, or their composition and summarizes each system in a profile card. Our evaluation of multimodal agents, vision-language-action models (VLAs), and world-action models (WAMs) shows that competence in a single view does not carry over to Mind2Act tasks. Even the stronges…

items.title: Learning through Discernment: when a small language model learns from user feedback on the job, and when it decays
items.summary: Small language models on devices could keep improving by learning, overnight, from their own daily work. Without a true outcome, however, something must decide which attempts are worth learning from, and both the model's own judgment and the user's reaction can be wrong. We study a small model (Qwen3 0.6B and 1.7B) with a LoRA adapter, fine-tuned each night on the attempts a judge accepts, over 127 lives of up to a year on WebShop and $τ^2$-bench. We compare the true outcome, the user's stated verdict and the model's own judgment with a separate, frozen "feedback sense" that reads the user's reaction, built in three versions. Judging itself, the model improved and then decayed, over a year and whatever its adapter. A sense that took polite give-ups for success collapsed 3 of 5 lives; one built for discernment, which first asks whether the user gave a clear verdict, kept 4 of 5 near the oracle for two weeks, then faded on clean but scarce lessons, to the level of self-judging by day 60. When the user cannot see the outcome ($τ^2$-bench), the sense read reactions correctly, yet 80% of its lessons were failures the customer had thanked. Across 97 lives, the share of failed attempts among the lessons predicted the outcome (Spearman $ρ$ = -0.81). In our experiments, learning from users held up only where the judge kept failures out and the user could see the outcome; lopsided lessons may also narrow the model.

items.title: Tideway: Phase-Aware Tiered Memory Management for MoE Inference on Consumer Devices
items.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are rapidly becoming a dominant paradigm for AI applications. Recently, there is a growing demand to deploy large-scale Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models locally on consumer PCs to balance data privacy, API costs, and inference efficiency. However, unlike datacenter servers with abundant DRAM, consumer devices are tightly constrained in both GPU VRAM and host RAM, forcing massive MoE weights to spill across VRAM, host RAM, and SSD. Under such spilling, we observe that existing systems fail to fully utilize this memory hierarchy, treating the tiers as independent caches and thrashing in inference. We present TIDEWAY, a system for efficient inference of large MoE models on memory-constrained consumer devices. Our core insight is to manage host RAM and GPU VRAM as a unified memory pool. Within this pool, TIDEWAY couples phase-aware memory layouts, which adapt to the distinct access patterns of prefill and decode, with an execution engine that optimizes CUDA Graph execution under expert paging. Our evaluations on representative consumer hardware with frontier MoE models demonstrate that TIDEWAY significantly outperforms state-of-the-art systems. On average, TIDEWAY achieves speedups of 1.97x in end-to-end latency and 2.40x in Time-to-First-Token (TTFT), along with 1.61x higher decode throughput against the fastest baseline. Our source code is publicly available at https://github.com/Afterglow231/Tideway .
items.title_zh: Tideway：面向消费设备的MoE推理内存管理
items.summary_zh: 消费设备内存受限，MoE模型权重需跨VRAM、主机内存和SSD存储。论文提出Tideway系统，将主机内存与GPU显存统一管理，结合阶段感知内存布局和CUDA Graph执行引擎，显著提升推理延迟和吞吐量。

items.title: AllocFlow: End-to-End Portfolio Trading Action Generation from Raw Market Data
items.summary: Real-world portfolio management requires converting noisy market observations into coordinated, simultaneous allocations across multiple assets under shared capital constraints. Advances in forecasting models and alpha discovery help identify opportunities. However, traditional pipelines often decouple signal forecasting from portfolio construction, potentially misaligning learning with allocation and execution objectives. We present AllocFlow, an end-to-end flow-matching framework that directly generates joint portfolio allocations from raw multi-asset market histories. To capture dependencies among portfolio positions, AllocFlow employs a cross-asset flow Transformer conditioned on temporal market representations to generate continuous, signed position weights across all instruments jointly. To address the sample inefficiency and instability of learning continuous allocation policies from scratch, we establish a two-stage training scheme: strategy-supervised imitation shapes a structured distribution of candidate portfolios, followed by group-relative reinforcement learning (RL) that refines joint decisions using portfolio-level financial rewards and a frozen policy reference. On hourly cryptocurrency perpetual futures, RL refinement raises the annualized net return of the imitation policy from 27.79% to 51.38% and its Calmar ratio from 0.955 to 4.043, surpassing the teacher strategy on every metric, and AllocFlow reaches a Calmar ratio of 4.90 on six further months of uns…

cad4623192ab.headline: 黎曼猜想证明通过验证，吴宝珠回应
cad4623192ab.body: 黎曼猜想证明通过Lean形式化核验，菲尔兹奖得主吴宝珠认为AI将推动数学繁荣。

44e795a5eb19.headline: NUS发布System One模型评测基准
44e795a5eb19.body: NUS发布System One模型评测基准，旨在评估模型在分流用户请求、选择工具操作等日常决策中的能力。

7715ef77627e.headline: 腾讯元宝×KCL发布群聊Agent记忆基准
7715ef77627e.body: 腾讯元宝与KCL联合发布GroupAssistBench，基于80,299条群聊消息构建评测题，检验Agent记忆的召回与使用能力。

c0f9e0924a06.headline: fast-anything：重写慢速代码
c0f9e0924a06.body: 该条目为使用编码代理优化代码的工具，与人工智能和开源关系不大。

71cbd0380775.headline: fast-anything：用智能体加速慢速代码
71cbd0380775.body: fast-anything 项目利用编码代理将 Python、Node 或 Ruby 应用中 5% 的慢速部分重写为 Rust。

febe0d9b6d42.body: anthropics/claude-cookbooks展示了使用Claude的有趣且有效方式的笔记本和食谱集合。

d083e89d922f.headline: superdesigndev/treg：智能体工具的OpenRouter
d083e89d922f.body: superdesigndev/treg提供智能体工具的OpenRouter，并包含社区Discord。

0ecdb317e210.headline: t8y2/dbx：轻量级跨平台数据库管理工具
0ecdb317e210.body: t8y2/dbx是一个25 MB的轻量级跨平台数据库客户端，支持100+数据库，内置AI和MCP。

9ea5cc87de0c.headline: wshobson/agents：Claude Code等工具的插件集合
9ea5cc87de0c.body: wshobson/agents为Claude Code、Cursor等工具编写了Markdown插件、智能体和技能。

1a8f4cf5181b.headline: OpenHands 发布 1.43.0 版本
1a8f4cf5181b.body: OpenHands发布v1.43.0版本，新增自动化、实验性功能页面、决策卡片渲染等特性。

676167064a4c.headline: Mind2Act World：具身智能体诊断基准
676167064a4c.body: Mind2Act World基准包含30个模拟操作任务，通过Mind、Act和Mind2Act三种视图评估系统的认知推理、物理执行及二者结合能力。

695750c92d8d.headline: Qwen3研究辨别反馈机制
695750c92d8d.body: 研究小模型如何通过辨别用户反馈来持续改进，发现基于辨别反馈的机制能保持性能。

8e81ce5c9af6.headline: Tideway优化MoE推理内存
8e81ce5c9af6.body: 提出Tideway系统统一管理主机内存与GPU显存，显著提升消费设备上MoE模型的推理延迟和吞吐量。

fdbd81232dec.headline: AllocFlow生成投资组合动作
fdbd81232dec.body: 提出端到端流程匹配框架，直接从多资产市场历史数据生成联合投资组合分配，提升投资收益。
